summary: BudgetTracker v2 (Emergent Google Auth + owner scoping + transfers + snapshots + rollover + budgets/share + charts + Excel export) fully tested. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_budget_api_v2.py — Auth (Bearer + 401 handling + /auth/session validation), owner-scoped list endpoints (categories/accounts/transactions/allocations), transfer creation moves balances (500->350, 100->250) and deletion reverts them, transfer requires from/to (400 if missing), balance snapshots upsert & set account balance, rollover copies categories to new month and sets brought_forward, budget CRUD + share_token generation (read-only 403 on PUT, writable 200 on PUT), unshare removes share_token, /api/charts returns net_worth_series/spending_by_category/planned_vs_actual/latest_month, /api/export/excel returns valid .xlsx (PK header, 3 sheets Summary/Transactions/Accounts). Frontend (375x667 mobile viewport, token 'cHtv5m1-...' injected into localStorage.budget_session_token): /login renders google-signin-btn without crash; injected token unlocks the (tabs) Dashboard showing $54,690.62 end-balance and $383.16 expense / $6,162.72 income; header-charts-btn/header-budgets-btn/header-settings-btn visible & tappable; Accounts tab shows accounts-fab, tapping opens menu-add-account/menu-add-tx/menu-transfer; transfer editor renders xfer-amount/xfer-from-btn/xfer-to-btn/xfer-save; tapping an account row opens account-detail with acc-add-tx/acc-add-transfer/acc-eom-btn; EOM modal renders eom-month/eom-balance/eom-save; Charts screen renders LineChart + PieChart + BarChart with 'Net worth over time', 'Spending by category', 'Planned vs actual' sections; Budgets screen renders budget-new + create modal with new-budget-name/new-budget-month-*/new-budget-save; Settings screen renders settings-logout. Shared route /shared/<token> renders public viewer with 'Editable' badge (write=true), shared-tab-expense/shared-tab-income switch lists correctly, tapping shared-cat-<id> opens edit modal (shared-edit-input) — save button (shared-edit-save) is present but sits below the mobile fold when input focus scrolls. Deprecated packages detected: none directly, but react-native-gifted-charts internally uses deprecated TouchableMixin and props.pointerEvents (non-blocking on RN Web).

ui_bugs.issue: On 375x667 viewport the shared-edit-save button falls outside the viewport when the input is focused; user must scroll the modal to tap Save. Reference: /app/frontend/app/shared/[token].tsx:223

issues: Edit modal likely needs KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView + sticky footer so shared-edit-save stays visible when keyboard opens.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings still present in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking on RN Web.

Charts screen triggers 'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' and multiple 'Unknown event handler property onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponderTerminationRequest/onResponderGrant/onResponderMove/onResponderRelease/onPressOut' console errors — coming from the library, non-fatal on RN Web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/charts.tsx

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~880 lines — still workable but should be split into routers (auth, budgets, transactions, exports) if more features are added.
MongoDB _id excluded via projection everywhere — good.
user_sessions has TTL index on expires_at — good; session cleanup automatic.

seed() legacy data (owner_id=None) is claimed only by the FIRST user to log in — subsequent testers with new tokens see empty data unless they were seeded manually. Consider documenting this in test_credentials.md and providing a per-user seed endpoint for QA.
Transfer balance math verified idempotent for create/delete but NOT tested for UPDATE with switched from/to accounts — recommend a follow-up test.
share_token uniqueness is not enforced by a unique index — collision probability is astronomically low but consider {unique:true, sparse:true} on budgets.share_token.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (1 minor modal-viewport UX issue on shared edit)

rca_of_issue: shared-edit-save UX: modal content in /app/frontend/app/shared/[token].tsx is not wrapped in KeyboardAvoidingView / ScrollView and the button sits at the bottom of the modal. On 375x667 viewport once the input receives focus (or the modal is rendered close to bottom-anchored), the Save button is pushed below the fold, requiring a scroll gesture to reach it. Fix: wrap modal body in KeyboardAvoidingView (behavior='padding') and add a fixed-position footer for the Save/Cancel buttons.
